name: Insert Coin Club
tagline: 1 follower = 1 arcade machine. The hall grows every day.

episodes.title: Day one
episodes.summary: One follower, one machine. The founder's cabinet powers on alone in an empty hall.

episodes.title: The first row
episodes.summary: 38 new followers, 38 new cabinets. @leo.taps and @mia_runs flank the founder.

episodes.title: Lights on
episodes.summary: The hall passes 100 machines and opens a second aisle.

episodes.title: Grows every day
episodes.summary: 92 new machines. The neon is visible from the street now.

episodes.title: Three hundred
episodes.summary: Machine #0300 switches on. Can we fill a second hall?
